verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Wrike's API has rate limits: it mentions a 'rate-limit-friendly design' and a Batch API that eases rate-limit pressure. No item documents actual request quotas, time windows, or concurrency caps a builder could plan against. The Batch API is an adjacent mitigation feature, not documentation of the limits themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale
